crossRefs.note: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me; for he has found favor in my sight.”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me; for he has found favor in my sight.”
translations.bsb: Then Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, “Let David remain in my service, for I am pleased with him.”
translations.kjv: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.
translations.asv: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favor in my sight.
